text:
If you were hoping the shower threat wraps up with sunset, not quite yet, that trough overhead is sticking around a bit longer. Skies are mostly cloudy tonight with another chance of showers and a stray rumble of thunder possible, especially earlier in the evening, before things quiet down some overnight. Lows settle around 56, and the lake's calming down too, winds easing to 5 to 15 knots with waves down to 1 to 2 feet if anyone's still out there.

Tuesday brings more of the same pattern, showers possible before 1pm and another round in the afternoon, though it should be more hit or miss than steady rain. The Euro's notably wetter than the American model on this one, so I'd keep the rain jacket handy even under partly sunny skies. High near 75, breezy from the west but easing, and the lake goes nearly calm by evening. Air quality's good, so no worries there. Bottom line: showers linger tonight into tomorrow, but nothing that should wreck a whole day, just keep an eye on the sky and don't plan an all-day lake outing without a backup.
